pages.title: Cooling
pages.text: While active this effect continually $(thing)Cools$() the player down to a minimum of $(n)5°C$()

pages.title: Kaista
pages.text: While active this effect continually $(thing)Warms$() the player up to a maximum of $(n)25°C$()

pages.title: Quenched
pages.text: While active this effect prevents the natural decay of $(l:cooking/food_and_water#thirst)Thirst$(). However, it does not prevent the Thirsty effect from decreasing your meter.$()

pages.title: Cure Parasites
pages.text: While active this effect gradually removes $(l:cooking/food_and_water#parasites)Parasite Contamination$() at a rate of about 1% every 10s at base level.$()

pages.title: Detoxify
pages.text: While active this effect gradually removes $(l:cooking/food_and_water#toxins)Toxin Contamination$() at a rate of about 1% every 10s at base level.$()

pages.title: Filter Microplastics
pages.text: While active this effect gradually removes $(l:cooking/food_and_water#microplastics)Microplastic Contamination$() at a rate of about 1% every 10s at base level.$()

pages.title: Freezing
pages.text: While active this effect continually $(thing)Cools$() the player down to a dangerously-low minimum of $(n)-20°C$(). Protective equipment is recommended to survive this condition.

pages.title: Blazing
pages.text: While active this effect continually $(thing)Warms$() the player up to a dangerously-high maximum of $(n)60°C$(). Protective equipment is recommended to survive this condition.

pages.title: Instant Radiation
pages.text: This effect quickly damages the player with $(l:game_mechanics/hazards#radioactive_materials)Radiation Damage$().

pages.title: Final Moments
pages.text: This effect starts a timer that counts down your last few minutes. When the clock ends, you die.
